description: Start with the full disk (covering radius 1), progressively remove arcs while maintaining univalent realizability, and track how the covering radius decreases. The infimum over all arc-removal paths gives the tightest possible upper bound from this construction family.
mathematical_formalization: D_t = D \ Γ_t, Γ_0 = ∅. R(t) = R(D_t) monotone decreasing. Hadamard: dR/dt = -∫_{∂Γ_t} |∇G(z,0)|^2 |V_n| ds. Extremal path minimizes ∫ |dR/dt| dt subject to univalent realizability.
implementation_hypothesis: Discretize boundary into 1000 points. At each step, remove small arc at location maximizing -dR/dt. Recompute conformal map and covering radius using SC toolbox.
experiment_seed: Start with unit disk. At each of 100 steps, test 36 candidate arc positions. Plot R(t) curve.
